messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] apac-sg-pool-2 p95 spike > 700ms, queue_depth rising, 5xx creeping. Paging on-call slot.

meera: oncall here, looking now. thanks.

darren: meera 1 1 who is on that pool? any big tenants?

kai: pulling allocation map: top tenants = shopquick (chat, multi-turn, ~52% RPS), dataflows (embeddings batches), smoke-tests. KV cache thrash and long-token jobs visible.

meera: quick impact note: shopquick sessions seeing truncation and delays, some long-gen 504s. No total pool failure yet.

darren: runbook suggests: try low-risk first -> tenant-level shaping, reduce non-sla default max_tokens, attempt spot/preemptible boost if reserve blocked, shed perf/smoke tests. Also watch cloud quota errors.

kai: trying reserve boost now but note cloud quotas in APAC often hit.

meera: /infra reserve-boost --pool apac-sg-pool-2 --add 2 --reason "emergency surge"

infra-bot: reserve-boost accepted. provisioning +2 reserved nodes. action_id=rb-apac-778. ETA ~30s.

kai: telemetry: reserve API returned a partial failure from cloud: region GPU quota at limit. infra-bot shows action pending manual approval (quota_exceeded).

infra-bot: action cb-998 created: cloud quota request for +2 GPUs in apac-sg. status=awaiting-approval (requested to cloud-team). If approval delayed, fallback to spot/preemptible nodes attempted.

meera: fallback plan: apply concurrency-slicing for shopquick (limit per-session concurrency), reduce non-SLA max_tokens to 2000, traffic-shed smoke-tests, and request spot boost. I'll apply the shaper first.

meera: /shaper apply --pool apac-sg-pool-2 --rule "concurrency-slice: tenant=shopquick max_concurrency_per_session=18 slice_token_cap=4096 priority=high" --reason "limit long-tail per-session during surge"

shaper-bot: rule created id=sh-7099. effective for new sessions.

kai: applying non-sla token cap via platform flag (temporary).

kai: /platform config set --pool apac-sg-pool-2 --feature max_tokens_default --value 2000 --scope non-sla --reason "reduce tail cost during surge"

deploy-bot: config applied to pool. no restart required.

meera: shedding smoke-tests now to free capacity.

meera: /traffic shed --pool apac-sg-pool-2 --match "smoke-tests/*" --action throttle-100pct --reason "free prod capacity"

deploy-bot: traffic-shed active id=ts-apac-55. inflight requests not affected.

kai: metrics 60s after shaper+config+shed: queue_depth 760 -> 310, p95 710ms -> 360ms, 5xx 1.4% -> 0.5%. good improvement.

infra-bot: cloud-team approved quota cb-998. proceeding with reserve provisioning now. action_id=cb-998-approve. estimated readiness ~40s.

meera: good. I'll hand SRE lead to darren for stabilization window; I'll take customer comms with cs-bot. darren you lead infra steps.

darren: taking lead. plan: monitor 20m; if p95 <450ms and 5xx <1% for 10m start rollback steps: 1) relax shaper, 2) re-enable a subset of non-sla tokens to 3000 behind canary, 3) de-shed smoke-tests, 4) release reserves.

cs-bot: notifying shopquick & dataflows support channels about mitigations and potential short latency or truncation on very long requests. message_id cs-1142.

meera: spot-boost attempted as additional headroom in parallel.

meera: /infra spot-boost --pool apac-sg-pool-2 --add 2 --reason "emergency preemptible capacity"

infra-bot: spot-boost request submitted; cloud returned partial success: 1 spot node granted, second queued due to region limits. id=spot-331. ETA for granted node ~25s.

kai: status (6m): p95 340ms, queue_depth 240, 5xx 0.3%, reserve nodes initializing and 1 spot node up. Nice recovery.

darren: proceeding with rollback step 1: relax shaper soften max_concurrency 18 -> 28.

darren: /shaper update --id sh-7099 --max_concurrency_per_session 28

shaper-bot: rule sh-7099 updated.

meera: initiating canary for raising non-sla token cap back to 3000 on node apac-sg-n11.

meera: /platform config set --node apac-sg-n11 --feature max_tokens_default --value 3000 --canary true

deploy-bot: canary config applied to apac-sg-n11. monitor for CPU/latency effects.

kai: canary metrics green. no CPU spike.

darren: step 3: removing smoke-tests shed.

darren: /traffic shed disable --id ts-apac-55

deploy-bot: traffic-shed ts-apac-55 removed.

kai: reserve and spot nodes fully ready. p95 310ms, 5xx 0.15%, queue_depth 120.

darren: final step: release 1 reserve (keep +1 as buffer) and keep spot until normal.

darren: /infra reserve-boost --pool apac-sg-pool-2 --add -1 --reason "gradual rollback"

infra-bot: reserve adjusted. action_id=rb-apac-779. deallocating 1 reserved node. ETA ~20s.

meera: preparing customer follow-up note summarizing mitigation steps, commands, and ask for shopquick to flag any regressions. cs-bot queued message cs-1146.

kai: post-mortem notes: cloud quota hit slowed immediate reserve provisioning; spot nodes helped as fallback. recommend increasing default reserve_budget by +1 for APAC pools and add an automated cross-region spillover policy for low-priority long gens. Also add a confirmation prompt for cross-region reserve commands.

darren: created follow-up INF-7701 with above recommendations and timeline.

meera: handing back to oncall rotation. I'll stay reachable for any customer replies in the next hour. thanks all :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident 1792234567 resolved -> monitoring. will auto-close if metrics stay stable.
